experiment: new noise-policy VIO repetitions; separate from original 18-run density-as-parameter experiment
meaning: Measured execution, partial coverage, error and timing evidence. Missing/failed runs retained; no accuracy or driving acceptance implied.

metrics.reference_interpretation: EuRoC supplied reference; for MH sequences orientation is observed only by IMU in the Leica+IMU batch solution, not independent motion-capture orientation

playback_policy.policy: VIO excludes images outside inclusive raw IMU time support; stereo VO keeps every image; no padding or retimestamping
playback_policy.coverage_denominator: all original stereo timestamps, including excluded images

runtime.imu_covariance: orientation unavailable (-1); gyro/accel unknown (zeros, ROS convention)
runtime.timing: monotonic dispatch lateness; receive data_age uses 1x replay epoch, includes queue delay

noise_policy.backend_model: vins/src/factor/integration_base.h: independent endpoint noise, V measurement=dt/2, V bias=dt
noise_policy.interpretation: Leading per-step covariance match to continuous density squared times dt; independent midpoint endpoints; not an exact correlated multi-step noise model or tuned accuracy guarantee

processing_gaps.limitation: Per-topic Image/CameraInfo receives were not counted; dispatch completion is not proof of DDS delivery. Processing-gap association does not establish the cause of sustained callback outages.
